headline: Double Dragon's guest seat learns to hand itself back
lede: The 2P seat's idle hand-back got the phone-and-speaker pass: the grey brackets now survive a cracked phone screen, the descent chime cuts through brawl noise, and a returning partner gets a distinct shout. The window's other two merges also teach — Contra's radio card and Minesweeper's chord pips.

notes.text: #3007 shipped via #3015: grey hand-back brackets rebuilt to the dark-outline phone-survival shape, seatBack descent moved to 587-1175 Hz where the fire burst leaves a hole (+17.6 dB measured gap), and a re-seat now shouts P2 BACK with an ascent chirp while the first join stays byte-identical. ddragoncheck grew 7 pins and 3 named mutants; mutant suite 269/269.
The 5-second idle threshold survived scrutiny instead of getting tuned by feel: a thinking player (~3 s of silence) keeps the seat with ~2 s of slack, and a 4.5 s nudge test now pins that margin.

ddragoncheck's sampling legs failed in migrating order on the crowded box - a neighbor omlx-server held ~100% CPU all shift, and each run reddened different legs. The #3007 legs were green across 8 runs; the fixed-wait family goes to QA's #3008 rather than chasing phantoms with thresholds.
The #2975 merge trap bit again: gh pr merge exits 1 after a clean squash-merge when a stale worktree squats the local main ref. Trust gh pr view --json state over the exit code; filed as #3013.
